nodes.html: Super guarantee and the 'Payday Super' shift
nodes.text: Super guarantee and the 'Payday Super' shift

nodes.html: From 1 July 2026, under 'Payday Super', employers must pay superannuation guarantee contributions alongside each payday — with contributions required to reach the employee's fund within 7 business days. Missing the deadline triggers the Super Guarantee Charge, employee complaints, and ATO scrutiny. Our matched firms implement Payday Super reporting and ensure contributions are calculated and paid correctly — before the deadline becomes a problem.

nodes.html: STP2 is mandatory for most employers and requires payroll data to be reported to the ATO each pay run. The data must be accurate, timely, and correctly coded — errors create reconciliation problems at year-end. Our matched bookkeepers and accountants set up STP2 correctly in your payroll software and keep it compliant each pay cycle.

nodes.text: Contractor vs employee — the grey zone

nodes.html: Misclassifying a worker as a contractor when they are legally an employee triggers back-paid super, PAYG, and penalties — sometimes years later. With the $190,100 high-income contractor threshold under Fair Work's Closing Loopholes legislation and the ATO's own contractor tests for super and PAYG purposes, getting classification right is essential. Our matched firms assess your arrangements and recommend the correct structure.

nodes.q: What is Payday Super and when does it start?
nodes.a: From 1 July 2026, under 'Payday Super', employers must pay superannuation guarantee contributions alongside each payday — with contributions required to reach the employee's fund within 7 business days. Late payment triggers the Super Guarantee Charge and ATO scrutiny. Our matched firms implement Payday Super-compliant payroll so you meet the deadline each pay cycle.
nodes.aText: From 1 July 2026, under 'Payday Super', employers must pay superannuation guarantee contributions alongside each payday — with contributions required to reach the employee's fund within 7 business days. Late payment triggers the Super Guarantee Charge and ATO scrutiny. Our matched firms implement Payday Super-compliant payroll so you meet the deadline each pay cycle.

nodes.q: What happens if I get contractor classification wrong?
nodes.a: Misclassifying an employee as a contractor can trigger back-paid PAYG, super guarantee, leave entitlements, and penalties — potentially years of exposure. The ATO and Fair Work use specific tests (not just the contract). The matched firm assesses your arrangements and confirms the correct classification, or restructures the engagement.

nodes.q: Do I need STP2 even for one or two employees?
nodes.a: STP2 is mandatory for almost all employers regardless of headcount — there are very limited exemptions. If you pay wages, you almost certainly need STP2 reporting each pay run. The matched bookkeeper or accountant sets this up in your payroll software and keeps it compliant.
